description: Peter Parker and Miles Morales begin in the original Ultimate universe, and Miles continues into Marvel's main universe. Brian Michael Bendis's Ultimate Spider-Man opens the journey alongside Ultimate Marvel Team-Up, Ultimate Six and Ultimatum. Ultimate Comics Spider-Man, Spider-Men, Spider-Man (2016) and Champions follow. The separate Earth-6160 Peter Parker stories are not included.
sourceOrigin: Compiled for this project from Comic Book Herald's guide, with the owner's Earth-6160 exclusions
